title: Rehob
sourceLines: -1. Father of Hadadezer, king of Zobah 2Sa 8:3,12
-2. A Levite who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah Ne 10:11
.The limit of the investigation made by the twelve spies Nu 13:21
-4. An unlocated town of Asher Jos 19:28
-5. A Levitical city of Asher Jos 19:30; 21:31; 1Ch 6:75
